# MORA

> MORA is a Ukrainian-language graphic design portfolio and design service website focused on brand identity, packaging design, digital design and art direction.

## Canonical URL
- https://mora.design/

## Contact
- Email: hello@mora.design

## Services
- Brand identity: strategy, logo systems, typography, colors, graphic system and brand guidelines.
- Packaging design: concepts, packaging systems, labels, adaptations and production preparation.
- Digital design: campaign visuals, social media, landing pages and digital touchpoints.
- Art direction: creative direction, campaigns, visual supervision and communication consistency.

## Selected portfolio projects
- Kulbaba — branding, 2026. Landscape brand identity: signs, typography, applications and visual language.
- Naturez — packaging, 2026. Premium packaging system with a dark tactile aesthetic.
- Sota — branding, 2025. Minimal identity with editorial typography and paper-inspired form.
- Aster Studio — art direction, 2025. Expressive art direction with a dark palette and light accents.

## Language
- Main website language: Ukrainian (uk-UA).
